'''Lyns Skutroo''' was a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] master [[Engineer/Legends|crafter]] who lived in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Waymancy Storm]], a conflict waged in [[7811 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and the [[Signatories of Waymancy]].<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref> In the [[7700s BBY]], Skutroo unveiled the [[squintpipe process]], a methodology for improving the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The squintpipe process<ref name="EGTW" /> was the culmination of work initiated during the Waymancy Storm by Republic [[Tech specialist|technologists]] at an [[Axum]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] to reverse-engineer<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Sif-Alulan process]],<ref name="EGTW" /> which had been used by the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]] to develop the advanced military technology of the Signatories of Waymancy.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The creation of the squintpipe process by Skutroo led to an improvement in energy weaponry and later on to a golden age in [[Warship/Legends|warship]] construction across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lyns Skutroo was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
